description: Round the corners of any image with an adjustable radius — perfect for avatars, cards and app UI — and download the result as a transparent PNG.

faqs.a: The corners are genuinely transparent, so the image blends over any background, dark or light.
Drag the radius all the way up and the image becomes a perfect circle (or oval for non-square images).
faqs.q: Can I make a circular image?

faqs.a: Square profile photos look best, but any image works.
No — everything is processed locally in your browser.

howto: Drag the corner-radius slider to taste.
Download it as a transparent PNG.
title: Rounded Corners Tool
